CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS listings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
  
  advertisement_id BIGINT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- also called "Listing ID" at Google Sheets
  listing_title TEXT, 
  property_type TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(10, 2),
  price_per_sqft NUMERIC(10, 2),
  bedrooms SMALLINT,
  bathrooms SMALLINT,
  furnishing VARCHAR(20),
  tenure VARCHAR(9),
  floors SMALLINT,
  car_parks SMALLINT,
  facilities JSONB,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  -- Location
);
